# Dragon Dice: Battle Box

Dragon Dice: Battle Box is a 1996 tabletop game supplement published by TSR for Dragon Dice.
Contents
Dragon Dice: Battle Box is a supplement in which an introductory set was aimed at welcoming new and younger players. It includes all essential components and a rulebook that guides players through the game mechanics with step-by-step instructions.
Reception
Chris Baylis reviewed Dragon Dice: Battle Box for Arcane magazine, rating it a 7 out of 10 overall, and stated that "the Battle Box is the introductory package that should have preceded all of the other Dragon Dice boxed sets. TSR has a habit of 'introducing' games long after they have been available on the open market. I'm sure there would now be many more Dragon Dice players if it had originally been available."
